title: Community agent benchmark endpoint: users share Benchmark this model results (opt-in, anonymous)
description: Approved 2026-09-29 (brief.md): users tick "Share the result anonymously" before a Benchmark this model run; the app server uploads a clean whole run to a Cloudflare Worker + D1 at bench.cubric.studio (source in mpi-ci/cubric-bench); the agent row shows one number per model (yours > ours > community median of >= 3 runs); the Worker serves a public leaderboard page. Privacy page updated in the same job. Plan: plan.md.
